name: A Fine Mess
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Requires level 20 instead of 24. Gives 5,800 experience instead of 2,450, 2.37 times as much. New rewards: Technician's Bracers. Read from what the game server sent in the beta. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
<Kernobee groans.> Wha.. What happened?

The last thing I remember is being captured by a group of dark iron dwarves, beaten to within an inch of my life and then thrown in here with these filthy troggs.

Get me out of here, adventurer!

Here's the plan: Lead me to the exit; if we make it out alive, you go to Booty Bay and let Scooty know that I went to Ratchet to warn Tinkerwiz of the dark iron's involvement in the making of that super rig.

Let's get going!
narrative.objectives: Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText: I suppose you should be rewarded for bringing Kernobee back to us in one piece, adventurer. If you go back to Gnomeregan, these might give you the edge you'll need in defeating that good-for-nothing backstabber, Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
